steps.note: Beira is always north/northeast of the waypoint and drops a permanent +10% Cold Resistance on first kill. Mud Burrow (optional, off the west side) has The Devourer miniboss for an Uncut Skill Gem, but it's a dead end most speedrunners skip.

Waypoint is near the center. Grim Tangle branches off from here too. Areagne (aka the frost witch — tough for her level, leans on cold degens and teleports) is an optional miniboss who drops an Uncut Support Gem; Gerung the Brambleghast nearby is a much easier optional kill for an Uncut Skill Gem.
Find the three Rust Altars to unlock the boss.
Back to town: get runic tools from Renly, click the three runes at the waypoint, then talk to Una.
Head to the entrance you skipped earlier.
Head opposite the entrance to find the exit. The Rotten Druid boss is optional but drops an Uncut Support Gem if you want the detour.
Clear the Mausoleum of the Praetor and Tomb of the Consort (Sorrow Among Stones quest) before fighting Lachlann — Draven and Asinia each drop an Uncut Skill Gem.
Follow the edges; points of interest are in the corners. The Crowbell grants a permanent +2 Skill Points on first kill.
Complete all 4 ritual encounters to spawn the boss (+30 Spirit, normal only).
Find Una's Lute near the center for a skill point reward.
Hug the right wall and head north. Turn in smithing tools to Renly (first character per league only).
Follow the U-shaped layout.

One big zone, not separate floors. Candlemass is optional but grants a permanent +20 Maximum Life on first kill — worth the fight. Count of Ogham completes Act 1. Talk to the Hooded One in town to move on to Act 2.
Follow the inside wall in a Z-shape pattern to a narrow canyon leading to the boss.
Speak to everyone, then use the desert map.
Follow an S/Z-shape pattern along a wall to the exit.
Static diamond layout — head north from spawn to find the boss.
Talk to Risu and Asala, then use the desert map.
Follow the yellow paper seals on the walls to find Balbala. Grants access to the Trial of the Sekhemas.
Keep close to the canyon, crossing it three times to find Jamanra. L'im the Impaler is an optional miniboss along the way that drops an Uncut Skill Gem.
Do your first ascendancy trial whenever ready, then head to Keth.
Run the outside edges to find the Venom Pit, then the exit (usually bottom right after the big bridge). Kabala grants a permanent +2 Skill Points on first kill.
Cross the V-shaped bridge and continue away from the entrance.
The crown-shaped boss tile is usually at the most northerly or east-facing point.
Hug a wall to find the exit and the Lightless Passage.
Boss room lines up with the entrance past the bone arch. Loot the Sun Clan relic from hyenas.
Click the three ancient seals around the edge, then place both relics in the medallion.
Sound the horn at the front of the caravan, then use the desert map.
Talk to the abandoned rhoa. Find the final letter near the big tower.
Tor Gul spawns directly opposite the entrance. Find the Sisters of Garukhan for +10% lightning res.
Linear — completes Act 2. Talk to the Hooded One, then Asala for Act 3.
The exit is on the far wall opposite the entrance — run along it.
Take the checkpoint/waypoint at the Venom Crypts entrance without entering yet. Mighty Silverfist grants a permanent +2 Skill Points on first kill.
Find the exits to Chimeral Wetlands, Azak Bog, and Matlan Waterways, taking each waypoint before backtracking.
Boss is in the top-right quadrant (+30 Spirit).
Find the corpse for the venom phial in the Den of the Serpent Priestess, then turn it in at Servi for a permanent buff (choice is final).
Follow the left-hand border. Also grants the Trial of Chaos entrance.
Find 2 of the 3 small soul cores to open the door. Blackjaw grants a permanent +10% Fire Resistance on first kill.
Activate the waypoint immediately, then find both medium soul cores and generators.
Pull every lever to lower the water, then the large one at the end.
Talk to Alva.
Take the waypoints for the Molten Vault and Apex of Filth (roughly NW/NE) before continuing.
Linear — kill the boss quickly (under 4 minutes) before molten gold floods the area.
Huge spiral layout — travel a full loop to reach the boss at the top wall.
Enter opposite the Drowned City.

bosses: Ketzuli, High Priest of the Sun
steps.note: Triangular layout — go up the stairs twice, staying in shade to avoid damage.
Boss and the Aggorat exit are both toward the right/north end of the zone.
Follow the Trial of Atziri voices across the plaza. Kill Vaal Goliaths until the sacrificial heart drops, then stab it at the sacrificial table for a skill point.
Completes Act 3 — his arena is opposite the entrance along the center line.
Speak to Doryani, Alva, then take the Boat Charter. Talk to Tujen/Ange/Kanu/Makoru to pick an island — Whakapanu first.
Find the Shark Pit (Great White One) and the Petrified Pirate for a torn map piece, then the far-end exit.
Boss is opposite the entrance in the circular/diamond layout. Unlocks the Shoreline Hideout.
Fully linear — boss is at the end, with a torn map piece along the way.
Kill monsters for the Chapel Key, open the Chapel Door for a permanent flask-recovery buff, then find the exit.
Linear — hug the wall the waves crash into.
Head away from the dock. Grab the wrecked-boat torn map piece. The Blind Beast (Primal Arena) drops a Greater Blank Rune; Mimok the Enslaved (Beast Pen, easy to miss) drops a Tier 4 Support Gem.
Boss is opposite the entrance in this long, winding zone. The Magma Twins (Volcanic Nest) are an optional pair that drop a Ruby or Topaz Ring depending on kill order.
Fully optional zone — grab the final torn map piece from the smuggler's stash, unlocking Plunder's Point.
Summon Tujen, kill Captain Hartlin for the Verisium, fetch Verisium Spikes from Dannig in town, then impale the totems and finish the Delirium encounter for a permanent +2 Skill Points.
All three main islands (Whakapanu/Shrike/Prison) done — head to Arastas next.
Follow Missionary Lorandis into the church, destroy the forcefield, then continue to the Excavated Pit.
Two blocks joined by a small square — hug a wall to find the Precursor Forge.
Talk to the Hidden One, then Rodri on the ship to sail to Ngakanu.
Linear snake-like funnel through three 'test of mettle' encounters. Pay respects at the Silent Hall for +5% max mana.
Find the three Hinekora Totems (corners of the zone) for attribute/resist bonuses before fighting Yama.
Talk to Navali for the Tattoo of Hinekora (+2 skill points).
Follow the boundary edge after leaving the large building.
Completes Act 4 — head north, opposite the nearest checkpoint. Onward to the Interludes.
Interlude 1 (Ogham). Entry point via the Hooded One in Kingsmarch. Talk to the Ferryman here for a one-time Greater Rune purchase before heading out.
Isolde & Heldra (optional) are to the east if you want the fight. Stones of Serle branches off to the south.
Initially sealed by Darkness — clear it to open the way into Holten.
Godwin & Sigbert (optional) and the Soul of the Ferryman encounter at the docks are both skippable side fights. Holten Estate branches off here too.
Oswin drops the Warden's Ledger for a permanent +2 Skill Points, plus a free unique item and a Vaal Orb.
Completes Interlude 1 — fight both together in the manor courtyard.
Interlude 2 (Khari Bazaar). Entry via the Hooded One. Akthi (worm) and Anundr (sandworm) are southeast of the entrance; defeating both grants a permanent +2 Skill Points.
Boss is at the end of the Sanctuary. The Two Wishes pedestals along the way drop rare jewelry/jewels from Djinn altars.
Activate the Molten One's Gift here for a permanent +5% Maximum Life.
Orbala's Pillar lets you pick 1 of 7 permanent Boons, swappable anytime. Qimah Reservoir (optional) is reached by summoning Jado.
Fully optional — click the giant vase to spawn the rare Bloodbilge.
Completes Interlude 2. Zarokh joins the fight once Azmadi drops below 70% HP.
Interlude 3 (Mount Kriar). Entry via the Hooded One.
No waypoint here. An Ancient Monument (Vaal Beacon) encounter drops a skill gem that scales with interlude order. Roving wisps guide the way to Kriar Village.
Lythara drops a permanent +40 Spirit via the Gemcrust Skull.
Guaranteed Expedition encounter here. Rakkar is to the northwest; defeating him reveals Kriar Peaks.
Reached via the Vaal Beacon at Glacial Tarn. Return the Yeti's tusks to Hilda for a permanent +2 Skill Points (Book of Specialization).
Elder Maddox (around 10-11 o'clock) offers a one-time free unique item choice.
Vaal Beacon is at the far end of the zone.
Completes Interlude 3 and the current campaign. Return to Kingsmarch and talk to the Hooded One for a final permanent +2 Skill Points, then use the map device with Doryani to enter the Atlas endgame.
